notes: Only one *again* is written for `וַיּוֹסֶף עוֹד`; it goes to the adverb whose own lexeme it writes (rule 11) and the auxiliary verb is unrepresented (rule 22). Giving it instead to `יָסַף` under rule 56 was the live alternative.
The waw coordinating the two verbs is the surplus one and is unrepresented, as rule 56's closing sentence directs.
